title: Small Talk at a Friend's Party
meta: B2 · 约 290 词 · 场景：朋友派对上的闲聊

lines.en: These satay are amazing, aren't they? Have you tried them yet?
lines.zh: 这沙爹太好吃了，对吧？你尝过了吗？

lines.en: Not yet, but they smell great. I'm Lee, by the way.
lines.zh: 还没呢，不过闻着很香。对了，我叫李。

lines.en: Rahul. Nice to meet you. So __how do you know__ Mei?
lines.zh: 我叫 Rahul，很高兴认识你。你是怎么认识 Mei 的？

lines.en: We used to work together at my last company. What about you?
lines.zh: 我们以前在我上一家公司共事过。你呢？

lines.en: Our daughters are in the same class. We bonded over the school WhatsApp group.
lines.zh: 我们的女儿在同一个班。我们是在学校的家长群里熟起来的。

lines.en: Ha, nice. Ours is three, so we're just starting to look at ==preschools==.
lines.zh: 哈，挺好。我家的才三岁，我们刚开始看幼儿园。

lines.en: Ah, that's a big decision. We spent months on it. What do you do, Lee?
lines.zh: 啊，那可是大事。我们当时纠结了好几个月。你是做什么的？

lines.en: **I manage an engineering team at a tech company. It's mostly meetings these days, to be honest.**
lines.zh: 我在一家科技公司带一个工程团队。说实话，现在基本都在开会。

lines.en: I know the feeling. I'm in ==logistics==, so my day is basically shipping delays.
lines.zh: 我懂那种感觉。我做物流的，每天基本就是处理货运延误。

lines.en: That sounds ==intense==. __How long have you been__ in Singapore?
lines.zh: 听起来压力挺大的。你来新加坡多久了？

lines.en: Almost ten years now. My wife's from here. What about you?
lines.zh: 快十年了，我太太是本地人。你呢？

lines.en: About two years. We're still ==figuring== out the best places to eat, so any tips are welcome.
lines.zh: 两年左右。我们还在摸索哪里好吃，有推荐的话欢迎告诉我。

lines.en: Hey, there you are! I wrote down the name of that preschool I mentioned.
lines.zh: 嘿，原来你在这儿！我把刚才说的那家幼儿园的名字写下来了。

lines.en: **Oh, thank you. I'm so sorry, I'm terrible with names. Could you remind me of yours?**
lines.zh: 哦，谢谢你。真不好意思，我特别记不住名字，你能再告诉我一下吗？

lines.en: No worries at all, it's Rahul. It happens to me all the time.
lines.zh: 完全没关系，我叫 Rahul。我也经常这样。

lines.en: Rahul, right. Thanks. So what's the preschool called?
lines.zh: 对，Rahul，谢谢。那家幼儿园叫什么？

lines.en: It's called Little Oaks, in Bukit Timah. They have a ==bilingual== programme in English and Mandarin.
lines.zh: 叫 Little Oaks，在武吉知马。他们有英文和中文的双语课程。

lines.en: That's exactly what we're looking for. Do they have a long ==waitlist==?
lines.zh: 这正是我们想要的。排队的人多吗？

lines.en: Pretty long, so I'd ==register== early. I can introduce you to the principal if you like.
lines.zh: 挺多的，所以我建议早点报名。你愿意的话，我可以介绍你认识园长。

lines.en: That would be really helpful. __Shall we swap numbers__?
lines.zh: 那就太有帮助了。我们交换一下电话吧？

lines.en: Sure, here's my phone. Just type yours in.
lines.zh: 好啊，这是我的手机，你直接输进去。

lines.en: **Done. Well, I'd better go find my wife. It was really nice chatting with you.**
lines.zh: 好了。我得去找我太太了。跟你聊天很开心。

lines.en: Likewise. Let's __catch up__ properly sometime, maybe with the kids.
lines.zh: 我也是。改天好好聚聚，可以带上孩子。

gist.q: Rahul 是怎么认识主人 Mei 的？他做什么工作？
gist.a: 他们的女儿同班，是在家长群里熟起来的；他做物流，每天处理货运延误。

gist.q: 第二次见面时「你」遇到了什么尴尬？怎么处理的？
gist.a: 忘了对方的名字；直接道歉说自己记不住名字，请他再说一遍。

gist.q: Rahul 推荐的幼儿园有什么特点？他还提出帮什么忙？
gist.a: Little Oaks，在武吉知马，有英文和中文双语课程，排队的人多；他可以介绍「你」认识园长。

prompts.q: 同事婚礼上你被安排和一桌陌生人坐。用 30 秒自我介绍，并抛出一个能让大家接话的问题。
prompts.ref: Hi everyone, I'm Lee. I work with Jason on the platform team, so I'm on the groom's side. I don't think I know anyone else at this table yet. How do you all know the couple? I'm guessing some of you go way back with them, maybe from school or university?
prompts.ref_zh: 大家好，我叫李，是和 Jason 一起在平台组的同事，所以算新郎这边的。这桌我好像谁都还不认识。大家都是怎么认识新人的？我猜有人跟他们认识很久了吧，可能是中学或者大学同学？

prompts.q: 派对上一个人一直拉着你聊，你想礼貌地脱身去找别人。说一段自然的收尾。
prompts.ref: It's been great hearing about your trip to Japan. I'm definitely adding Hokkaido to our list. I should go and say hi to Mei before it gets too late, though. I haven't even talked to the host yet. Let's grab a drink later if you're still around. Enjoy the rest of the party.
prompts.ref_zh: 听你讲日本之旅真有意思，我一定把北海道加进我们的清单。不过我得趁还不太晚去跟 Mei 打个招呼，我到现在都还没跟主人说上话。待会儿你还在的话我们再喝一杯。玩得开心。

words.ex: Our son starts preschool in January.
She works in logistics for a shipping company.
The last week before the move was pretty intense.
We're still figuring out which bus goes to the zoo.
We want a bilingual school for our daughter.
We've been on the waitlist for three months.
You need to register online before the class starts.
We swapped numbers so we could arrange a playdate.
Let's catch up over lunch next week.
